answer: The first-line antibiotics recommended for uncomplicated cystitis in women are Nitrofurantoin for 5 days or Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole for 3 days. [IDSA Uncomplicated UTI Guideline, 2019] Fluoroquinolones should be reserved for cases where first-line agents are not suitable. Please consult a professional for further review and individual patient care considerations.

results.content: Nitrofurantoin for 5 days or trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole for 3 days are first-line agents for uncomplicated cystitis in women. Fluoroquinolones are reserved for cases where first-line agents are not suitable.
